Summary The PGIM Quant Solutions Large-Cap Value Fund outperformed the Russell 1000 Value Index (the Index) in the second quarter of 2026. The Fund outperformed its benchmark in eight of the eleven sectors during the quarter. The Fund’s strongest relative performance during the quarter came predominately from the Financials and Information Technology sectors.

Global equities surged during the quarter, recovering from a March sell-off, driven by continued and accelerated Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) optimism, strong corporate earnings, and easing geopolitical concerns.

PGIM Investments, a subsidiary of PFI, is an investment adviser and the investment manager to all PGIM US open-end investment companies and manager or administrator to closed-end investment companies.
